section_heading: Visiting Vessels (not engaged in trade) Foreign/Local yachts (port dues)
plain_summary: This page outlines the port dues for visiting vessels, specifically foreign/local yachts, that are not engaged in trade. It details a free stay period of 30 days, followed by escalating daily rates per metre of length overall, depending on the total duration the vessel remains in port. Rates are provided for the next 90 days, the subsequent 90 days, and then for the remaining period up to 12 months, with a higher rate for stays exceeding 12 months.
